messages:
Jules (Finance): FYI invoice INV-2026-314 for Vesta AG (private EU) landed with platform fee   wait, line has 'eu-deployment-surcharge' +
BillingBot: Invoice INV-2026-314 issued. Total: 89,600. Lines: `platform_private: 80,000`, `eu-deployment-surcharge: 8,000`, `support_enterprise: ,000`.
Ravi (FinanceOps): Pulling contract now. I don't see any surcharge in the signed Master Svc Agmt (MSA) or in SOW v2. Only the internal quote had an 'estimated region uplift'.
Sofia (Account Executive): Customer signed SOW v2 on 2025-11-30. We did an addendum email for EU datacenter preference but I don't recall a percentage. Sales ops might have applied a 10% uplift by mistake.
Emil (Customer Success): We did provision EU-only dedicated cluster on 2026-01-05. There was a temporary trial node pool created 2026-01-18 for load testing; CS flagged it as non-production.
Ravi (FinanceOps): Looks like billing included the trial pool month. Also systems applied a default region uplift of 10% because 'region' flag was set on deployment. That wasn't supposed to be auto-applied for existing island customers.
Jules (Finance): Two issues then: (1) remove trial pool charges, (2) confirm whether the region uplift is contractually authorized. If not, need credit and corrected invoice.
Sofia (Account Executive): I'll attach the signed SOW and the email addendum to this thread. SalesLeader verbally approved a one-time professional services fee, not a recurring region uplift.
LegalBot: Note: Billing adjustments require Change Order or written approval. Verbal approvals are insufficient for recurring fee changes.
Ravi (FinanceOps): Created ticket BILL-4419. Provisional credit CM-9221 drafted for -8,000 (surcharge) and CM-9222 for -2,000 (trial pool). Status: pending finance lead.
BillingBot: CM-9221 and CM-9222 created (pending_approval).
Emil (Customer Success): Customer AP needs new total for payment processing. They asked for an explanation line: "Removed trial/test nodes and incorrect region uplift."
Jules (Finance): Can we get corrected invoice + credit memo with explanation and copy AP (ap@vesta.ag) by Friday EOD CET?
Ravi (FinanceOps): Will aim for Friday. If Legal insists on written CO for recurring uplift, we should revert uplift and bill moving forward only if CO signed.
Sofia (Account Executive): I'll get written confirmation from the customer today and loop SalesOps. If they sign, we can reapply uplift prospectively.
Jules (Finance): Thanks. Please post the corrected invoice draft here when ready. Also include a brief note for the customer about timing of refunds/credits.
Sofia (Account Executive): On it. :white_check_mark:
Emil (Customer Success): I'll notify the customer about the expected corrected invoice and timeline.
Ravi (FinanceOps): Updating BILL-4419 with action items and ETA 2026-02-09 if approvals slow, or Fri if signed CO received today.
